Product images for the site live under this folder (served at /photos/...).

- bouquet/, flashcards/, frames/, giftbox/ — catalog & mock data
- bouquet/gallery/ — extra bouquet images for the home page gallery

Add carousel images as img-1.jpg, img-2.jpg, … in a /PHOTOS/ route only if you wire that separately; the app uses the paths above.

About Us page hero & closing banner: place your image as 28499410138204236.jpeg in this folder (URL /photos/28499410138204236.jpeg).
